description: Point the project's "Go to App" quick-link at its running dev server via PATCH /projects/:id/app-status, with LAN network-host override and optional health endpoint.

kbApiBase.description: KainBain API base URL the stage agent should call.

targetProject.description: Name (or slug) of the project whose app link is updated. Defaults to the current project. Accepts a project id, name, or slug; the stage editor offers a dropdown of known projects.

networkHost.description: LAN hostname or IP that replaces localhost/127.0.0.1 in the stored app URL for remote viewers (e.g. lan-host.example). Blank means no override; host:port also overrides the port.

healthEndpoint.description: Optional path the backend health probe appends to the app URL (e.g. /health). Blank probes the app root.

defaultPort.description: Port hint when the project's dev server port is fixed and known (e.g. 5173). Blank means the agent detects the port from the running process.

context: You may update the target project's "Go to App" link to reflect the dev server this run started, moved, or stopped. Set the link when the app starts, merge status-only updates while booting, and clear the link when the app stops.
